rationale: The assistant correctly identified E18 as a drainage fault, told the customer to 'Switch off and unplug the machine' before opening the service flap, warned that 'there may be quite a lot of water', and ordered checks sensibly (filter first, then hose and waste, then pump as less likely). It used only the customer's reported evidence, concluded the sock/hair grip/fluff blockage matched the hidden truth, and correctly stated 'No pump replacement or engineer is indicated unless E18 returns', matching the ground truth escalation and no-part expectation. Preventive advice about children's items and periodic filter cleaning was proportionate and useful.
